name: lucia-reclaimed-blight-enter-look-six-reveal-deep-spell-to-memory-rest-bottom
notes: Lucia, Reclaimed Blight (fIQR28QmYg): Class Bonus on (champion patched to Kongming, Fel Eidolon, MAGE/TERA). Top six: DG, FS, Fairy Whispers (Spell), DG, Fairy Whispers (Spell), FS; Charge the Soul is the 7th (marker). Both Spells are offered; the 5th card is revealed into memory and the other five go to the bottom in their original order. Pre-fix nothing at all was put on the bottom after the reveal.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Look at the top six cards of your deck. You may reveal a Spell card from among them and put it into your memory. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Three defects in the generated SignalTech X Ultra / Lucia pair plus the shared ResolveTopDeckOptionalSelection() (GameLogic.php). (1) The helper put the 'rest' on the bottom with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myDeck"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only ONE of the looked-at cards ever went to the bottom (live repro on HEAD, no candidate: only the top card moved to the bottom, the rest stayed on top). Fixed with MZMoveTopOfZone() plus a trailing CleanupRemovedCards(). (2) The generated follow-up handler passed an UNDEFINED $topCount to the helper (the variable only exists in the other closure), so after a reveal the remaining count was 0 and NOTHING at all was put on the bottom (live repro: the Spell taken, the other cards stayed on top of the deck). (3) The follow-up was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the optional reveal (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) skipped it and the looked-at cards were never put on the bottom. (2) and (3) live in generated closures (gitignored), so both closures are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php: the look count is carried in the TopDeckOptionalCount decision-queue variable and the follow-up is queued with dontSkipOnPass:1.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ResolveTopDeckOptionalSelection() / Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php vFvhZeunOc:0 + fIQR28QmYg:0 closures and their follow-up handlers
